about: Rung 9's numbers. `fixed` come from the ladder or the owner's answers. Every `slots` entry is a number or choice the contracts leave open: status open, with a proposed value, and score.py refuses a scored run while any is open. To close one, set its status to closed and its value. A preview runs on the proposals and is never a gate.

max_decision_ms.source: ladder rung 9 (A9): each decision, aims included

area_share.source: owner choice 8: of the visible patch, at the floor

visible_share_min.source: owner choice 8: of the patch, to be scored

anticipation_floor.note: the candidate's anticipation rate must reach this, fixed before the run

stability_floor.note: the candidate's stability rate must reach this, fixed before the run

surrogate_definitions.note: the contracts name the two rates and say the incumbent scores 0 and 1, but give no formula; need-raise-v0 is in README.md

anticipation_window_s.note: need-raise-v0: how soon after need moves into engaged the raise must come

anticipation_rise_min.note: need-raise-v0: the smallest relative rise in predicted light at the person's surface that counts

stability_dwell_s.note: need-raise-v0: a need-driven change followed by another sooner than this was unstable; 120 s is evening-ambience@2's min_dwell_s

surface_map.note: which of the light model's blocks form each surface, {surface_id: [point_id, ...]}: the owner marks them on rung 8's grid, whose blocks have no surface id. It must name 'room', the task of a person with no working region, which is need v0's only track. It reaches a real model only: a fake keeps its own surfaces. The proposal names no block, so a preview stays at the model's own surfaces or the whole view, and closing the slot at it still refuses a score

look_brightness.note: the seed Look's reference scene on each bulb, 0-255: the look's values are the owner's; below full so a free bulb has room to re-serve

look_kelvin.note: the seed Look's colour temperature, as in the schema's reading target

look_fade_s.note: the seed Look's transitions.fade_s; 2 s is den_lighting's own fade

look_weights.note: the seed Look's weights: relative shortfall and excess at a target surface, and distance from the look's level

solve_steps.note: evenly spaced brightness steps the solve tries per free bulb

glare_limit.note: the seed Look's glare limit at eyes, in the light model's G units; no numeric limit exists yet

glare_sd_k.note: G_hi = G + k x sd, the upper bound the limit is tested on

exposed_fraction.note: recipients.exposed: an eye counts as exposed when G_hi is above this share of the limit

s_serve.note: recipients.served: smallest task share; attribution-thresholds, deferred by the owner

met_tolerance.note: a target counts as unmet, for hold_limited, when predicted light is this far under it

compensation_option.note: compensation, pending: P0, P1, P2 or P3; the register's advice for rung 9 replay is P1 mode, with P0 and P3 as counterfactual scenes

compensation_form.note: compensation, pending: strict or mode, for P1 to P3

p3_fallback.note: compensation, pending: P3 with an unknown changer falls back to P1 or P0

footprint_threshold.note: compensation parameter: a block is in a hold's footprint when the change moved its light by this share

footprint_membership.note: compensation parameter: at_or_above or above the threshold

manual_vs_safety.note: manual-vs-safety, pending: only S0 (manual wins, flagged) is built, the register's advice for the Hue path

record_extensions.note: the Decision keys the contracts do not name, listed in README.md
